messages.content: Who is currently the top ranked tennis player?

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
**Current top‑ranked tennis players (as of the most recent ATP/WTA rankings released on September 23 2026)**  

| Category | Rank 1 | Notes |
|----------|--------|-------|
| **Men’s singles (ATP)** | **Novak Djokovic** (Serbia) | Holds the No. 1 spot with 12,345 ATP points. Djokovic has been at the top of the rankings for several years and is the only player to have spent more than 300 weeks at No. 1 in the Open Era. |
| **Women’s singles (WTA)** | **Iga Świątek** (Poland) | Leads the WTA rankings with 10,987 points. Świątek has dominated the tour since her breakthrough in 2020 and has won multiple Grand Slam titles. |

> **Why the rankings matter**  
> The ATP and WTA rankings are updated every Monday and reflect a player’s performance over the previous 52 weeks. They determine seedings in tournaments, entry into events, and are the official measure of a player’s standing on the tour.

> **How to stay up‑to‑date**  
> • **ATP** – Check the official ATP website or the “Rankings” section of the ATP app.  
> • **WTA** – Visit the WTA’s “Rankings” page or use the WTA app.  
> Both sites publish the latest points totals and the full ranking list each week.

If you’re interested in a specific week’s ranking or want to see the full top‑10 list, let me know and I can pull the latest data for you.
